issues.quote: his father's silver watch had run badly for ten years and that he would not let anyone touch it, not even his uncle
issues.fact: O1 says only that Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine. The sheet does not say which watch Félix owns or whether it is reliable.
issues.misreading: The reference to a silver watch that 'had run badly' sits directly after the 8:40 reading, so a solver could take the 8:40 watch to be the unreliable silver one, or wonder whether Félix showed a different watch than the one he means. The sentence is clearly about a separate watch, so the risk is small.

issues.quote: Monsieur Girard and my husband quarrelled about the repeater.
issues.fact: The sheet mentions no repeater and no quarrel. The watch-related details here are not part of the fact sheet.
issues.misreading: A repeater is a striking watch. A solver could read the introduction of a striking watch as a hint about which timepiece struck or when, but it does not change any stated reading.
